claims: deterministic repro: 4 failing contract assertions prove (a) SkillPathPanel renders foreign element branch tabs for a committed-fire spell player, (b) combat bar renders an empty 'Ultimate' slot button for a beta player, (c) AlchemyView renders dormant pill-family recipe rows, (d) betaCompletionFor has zero UI consumers (ending beat unwired)
limitations: component mounts in jsdom; visual styling not assessed

body.title: SkillPathPanel renders the 4 non-committed element branches as browsable locked tabs, violating contract sec.D scope-hidden mandate

locations.symbolOrSection: sec.D: non-committed branches scope-hidden; render verdicts verbatim, never recompute

body.discoveredBy: coord-main read-model honesty census (beta read-model consumer enumeration)
body.counterexample: committed-fire spell_pathway player opens skill panel -> element tab strip renders Hoa/Kim/Thuy/Moc/Tho; selecting a foreign tab browses its locked tree
body.expected: contract sec.D: the 4 non-committed element branches are scope-hidden post-commit - do not render; no teaser, no 'locked'
body.actual: all 5 element tabs render; foreign branches browsable with locked treatment (deterministic: tab 'Moc' rendered for committed 'fire')
body.rootCause: UI bypasses the canonical beta read-model and renders scope-hidden content through its own filtering

siblingSearch.termsAndMethod: enumerated every exported beta read-model in src/core/betaScopeSurface.ts + src/core/betaScopeSkillDomain.ts + GameManager facade methods, then grepped src/components|stores|composables for a consumer of each; for each unwired/parallel-verdict surface inspected the UI's own filtering for dormant-content leaks
hitDispositions: F-RM-1 confirmed: SkillPathPanel iterates ELEMENT_ORDER directly; betaSkillTreeFor/activeElementTreeFor have zero UI consumers
F-RM-2 confirmed: TurnCombatSkillBar iterates fixed ROLE_ORDER; betaCombatRolesFor unwired; empty ultimate slot renders
F-RM-3 confirmed: betaCompletionFor zero UI consumers; ending beat never displays
F-RM-4 confirmed: AlchemyView filters raw getAlchemyRecipes by realm+retired only; getBetaAlchemyRecipeModels unwired; 4 dormant families render
StageSelectPanel closed: catalog contains only in-scope stages; locks render via domain stageLockReasonCode
QuestPanel closed: isBetaQuestEnabled gates unlock/projection/claim in QuestSystem
EquipmentHall closed: isBetaEquipmentTab consumed
Realm ladder closed: betaRealmLadderNodes consumed by RealmPanel
Wheel/buildings/panels/left-modes closed: betaWheelSlots/isBetaBuildingSurface/isBetaStandalonePanel/isBetaLeftPanelMode all consumed
getWorkerLodgeSurfaceModel unwired but worker_lodge itself is scope-hidden - moot
stageSpawnableEnemyIds consumed by StageWaveSystem funnel
coverageLimits: consumer census by name grep; a consumer importing under an alias not containing the read-model name would be missed (all exports use distinct names, verified by re-grep on facade method names)
